summary: Animal IV literature CL and volume regressions were checked against withheld species including humans. Human prediction varied substantially across compounds despite high animal-fit correlations.
validation: Cefepime extrapolation performed better than ceftazidime and ceftriaxone. Distinguish the animal-only validation from the ceftazidime figure refitted with human data. A high R-squared is not an external prediction check.
data_availability: Open aggregate tables and supplementary literature PK compilation; individual raw data and executable code not verified.
code_availability: Executable estimation code not verified; an accessible paper is not an executable model.
